crm_mapping: revenue/production_survival/crm.md stage 'Public pain captured': phrase plus source URL. Airtable base JOJO Revenue Recovery CRM is the system of record; this file is research input only, not a second CRM. Batch 1: public_pain_signals_20260830.json — none of these duplicate it.

signals.pain_phrase: update_state can permanently erase messages when the checkpointer is config-injected — local testing never catches it; the bug only exists in the config-injected shape, i.e. exactly and only in production
signals.who: LangGraph Platform operator; get_state returns messages:[] for a thread with full history, and update_state commits the emptiness forward permanently
signals.binary_test_fit: Given a state read that hydrates empty, when update_state runs, then the system refuses to commit against an unverified empty read — a visible stop path instead of permanent erasure
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should preserve conversation state across reads, but in production it silently erases the thread and every later run continues from nothing.
signals.contact_route_status: NONE — public GitHub issue; owner decision

signals.pain_phrase: reading a nested subgraph's state hydrates every DeltaChannel empty, silently — we had 1452 kB of messages blobs in checkpoint_blobs while the API reported messages: []
signals.who: Team running per-run inspection on finished LangGraph runs; every nested agent came back with an empty transcript while the data sat on disk
signals.binary_test_fit: Given 1.4 MB of checkpoint blobs on disk, when the state API is read, then the read either returns the data or fails loudly — never a plausible-looking empty transcript
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should report the work it actually did, but in production the run history reads empty while the data sits on disk.
signals.contact_route_status: NONE — public GitHub issue; owner decision

signals.pain_phrase: invalid state saved to checkpoint without validation, causing permanent corruption — the checkpoint is saved successfully but cannot be retrieved later; unrecoverable graph execution failures
signals.who: LangGraph user whose thread history was permanently corrupted by an unvalidated node output; no native way to pinpoint which node wrote it
signals.binary_test_fit: Given a node returning schema-invalid state, when the node completes, then validation fails before the checkpoint write — corruption never becomes permanent
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should fail safely on bad state, but in production it saved the corruption and the whole thread became unrecoverable.
signals.contact_route_status: NONE — public GitHub issue; owner decision

signals.pain_phrase: in a multi-agent system I ran in production, the failure signature looked like healthy iteration for a long time — the agents were genuinely doing work, reprocessing the same input from a slightly different angle; the loop terminated on max turns, not on a progress signal
signals.who: Production multi-agent operator commenting on AutoGen's Infinite Agreement Loop proposal; framework has no awareness of semantic progress
signals.binary_test_fit: Given agents making state mutations without progress, when N cycles produce no convergence, then a deterministic stop fires — not a max-turns timeout after the budget is gone
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should escalate when a path is not working, but in production it iterated healthily on the same input until the turn cap.
signals.contact_route_status: NONE — public GitHub issue; owner decision

signals.pain_phrase: every time an Agent makes an LLM query that lasts more than 4 minutes (exactly) it crashes — n8n cannot reliably handle very long single-call LLM generations, regardless of model or infra; the workaround is architectural, not configuration-based
signals.who: Multiple n8n self-hosters (thread January 2026) whose production AI Agent nodes die at exactly 4 minutes; env timeouts documented as having no effect
signals.binary_test_fit: Given an LLM call exceeding the stream timeout, when the wall hits, then the workflow fails with a visible receipt and resumes chunked — not a bare 504
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should survive long generations, but in production it dies at exactly four minutes no matter what I configure.
signals.contact_route_status: NONE — community forum account required; owner decision

signals.pain_phrase: reverse proxies like Cloudflare time out the idle connection (~100s) and inject a raw 524 error HTML page into the chat stream — the user sees jumbled HTML markup even though the agent eventually completes successfully
signals.who: n8n core team documenting a production failure mode: successful agent executions presented to users as garbage HTML
signals.binary_test_fit: Given a long tool call behind a proxy, when the proxy times out, then the user sees a held connection or a clean error — never raw error HTML masquerading as the agent's answer
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should show its real result, but in production the user gets a Cloudflare error page injected into the chat.
signals.contact_route_status: NONE — public GitHub issue; owner decision

signals.pain_phrase: an Analyzer and a Verifier fell into mutual recursion; eleven days later the bill was $47,000 — the dashboard showed the spend climbing, but no enforcement; by the time the page fires, every API call between the alert and the human reading it has already happened
signals.who: November 2025 incident report: team running four LangChain agents; same post cites a 35-engineer SaaS shop with an $87,000 April 2026 bill and one developer's autonomous refactoring weekend burning $4,200
signals.binary_test_fit: Given two agents in mutual recursion, when the loop starts, then a hard budget ceiling enforced outside the model halts the run in minutes — not after eleven days
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should stop when the budget says stop, but in production two agents looped for eleven days and cost us $47,000.
signals.contact_route_status: NONE — blog author; the incident team is unnamed; owner decision

signals.pain_phrase: every API call succeeded, every trace logged correctly — the system was not failing, it was executing successfully into bankruptcy; a per-execution cost ceiling would have halted it in minutes
signals.who: Prevention-stack vendor analyzing the reported $47K loop; the phrase names the exact gap: observability without enforcement
signals.binary_test_fit: Given a runaway loop with perfect observability, when spend crosses the ceiling, then enforcement fires inside the execution path — observability alone demonstrably did not
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should be stoppable by infrastructure, but in production our dashboards watched it spend for eleven days.

signals.pain_phrase: 247 tool calls across three production services, 38 errors, running since Friday night — a billing-dispute agent stuck in a retry loop over the weekend, hitting payment APIs repeatedly, potentially creating duplicate refund attempts, 50 other leads queued behind the stuck pipeline
signals.who: DVARA governance writeup of a customer-support agent scenario: structural error misread as transient, discovered Monday morning
signals.binary_test_fit: Given a structural API error, when the second identical retry fails, then the agent halts and escalates instead of retrying the whole sequence for a weekend
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should know a structural error from a transient one, but in production it retried a billing flow 247 times over a weekend.

signals.pain_phrase: a multi-agent system can run at roughly 15x the tokens of a plain chat interaction; a loop engineered without an explicit budget ceiling doesn't fail loudly when it hits that multiplier — it fails as a bill, days later, once someone reads the invoice
signals.who: Practitioner series on production loop guardrails citing Anthropic's published multiplier; names the stuck-loop detector (compare state across iterations, stop when nothing changes)
signals.binary_test_fit: Given a 15x token multiplier on multi-agent runs, when the loop misbehaves, then an infrastructure-layer ceiling catches it before the invoice does
signals.draft_sentence: My agent should fail loudly, but in production it fails as a bill days later.
